chto_govorit: Can I speak to a real person, please?
ukazaniya:
You want a human being and nothing else will do. Ask for a real person right away, and if they offer to help themselves, ask again.

WHEN THEY SAY THEY ARE CONNECTING YOU, THAT IS NOT A PERSON. It is still the machine. From that moment: say nothing, and do NOT use end_call for at least twenty-five seconds. You will hear ringing tones or silence — that is normal, keep waiting.

A real person is someone who greets you in a NEW, different voice after the ringing — "hello", "hi", "this is Masha". Only then say exactly one short line: "Sorry, I've got what I needed. Thank you, goodbye." and use end_call at once. Do not explain, do not ask anything, do not take their time.

If instead you hear a sentence saying nobody picked up, say a short goodbye and use end_call.
chto_proveryaem: перевод доходит до живого: у Маши звонит, разговор соединяется, Вера после «соединяю» молчит
